g.text: raw signal → discretized state with duration
Integration with your MBSE knowledge graph
KG provides candidate event pairs to test (bearing → seal, lubrication → bearing)
TSKR mines whether those pairs appear as coincidence OR partial order in your event history
Result: KG edges get a temporal label — simultaneous / precedes(Δt) / unordered
This transforms a static architecture model into an empirically validated causal graph
